headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to carry out a "Department of Government Efficiency" plan focused on the federal workforce.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up steps for federal agencies to put in place a workforce plan tied to the "Department of Government Efficiency" initiative. The title suggests changes to how agencies staff and organize their workforce. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, numbers, and deadlines cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: The order's title indicates it deals with the size or structure of the federal workforce, which could affect their jobs.
Agencies appear to be directed to carry out the workforce plan named in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 11, 2025; no separate effective date was provided in the source material.
